replies.author: @davidzamora4456
replies.text: Stop misinformation. The Baja California peninsula is about 1000 kilometers long stretch of land with multiple weather areas. The northern part close to the US border has the sane climate as San Diego. Not extremely hot nor humid. San Felipe is warmer and dry because it’s close to the dessert. The south is warmer in the summer and a bit humid depending on the season. Close to Ensenada is the Guadalupe Valley where there are many famous vineyards with a Mediterranean climate. The mountains weather is cooler. So as you can see there are many types of weather conditions throughout Baja.
